mission: First Claude identity proofs (owner 2026-10-29, perfectionist, 'every card priced'). 13 retained physical artwork reviews of ambiguous Yuyu-Tei listings captured 2026-10-16 (review_pack of identity-capture-work run 40842064693), added to positive_physical_artwork.json under claude_visual_review_of_unique_full_physical_artwork / claude:retained-full-image-visual-review-2026-10-29. For each, the listing image and every official sibling image were fetched once with an honest User-Agent (59 requests, all HTTP 200), each body's SHA-256 matched the retained 12-hex prefix, no sibling pair is pixel-identical, and the reviewer named the one print whose full artwork the listing shows and why each other sibling is excluded. Candidate 2884 (OP05-119 SP p6/p7) is skipped: its foil colour fits neither sibling cleanly. The registry is a collector runtime input (resolver runs in the collectors), so all ten collectors are released; on the next Yuyu discovery turn per category the 13 listings re-resolve to exact (reason retained_positive_unique_physical_artwork_review). No mapping is written by this PR: approval stays an owner-approved approve-f1-batch dry run and apply.

impacts.reason: 13 appended proofs, existing 298 untouched. Each is validated on every resolver run by physical_artwork_proof.validate (staging only), which refuses unless capture, snapshots, full hashes, release, sibling set and listing identity still match; a refused proof leaves the listing ambiguous. identity_weakening and ambiguous_approval are false: these are positive reviews of retained bytes under the existing validator, and mappings still need the owner-approved approval batch. The infrastructure effect is the mission-scoped release of the ten collectors (both collector images import the registry: collector_runtime_inputs import-graph).

routes: no new source request: discovery fetches what it fetched before; the review fetches ran from the reviewer's session, not from staging
impact.deployment_impact: All ten collectors re-uploaded on the merge commit, one at a time with automatic rollback. Behaviour change: on the next discovery turn of op11, op12, op13 and op14, up to 13 ambiguous Yuyu-Tei proposals become exact proposals. No mapping, price or Market Value change until an owner-approved approval batch.

recovery.procedure: The rollout captures each collector's live deployment before upload and restores it on failure (recovery_deployment_id rows are reference only, carried from the #239 mission because #239's delivery receipt is not readable from the session); afterwards collector-redeploy to the fleet pin. Code: native revert PR with its own mission file; a reverted proof only returns its listing to ambiguous.
recovery.trigger: A collector failing after release, a proposal refresh raising, or a listing resolving to a print its proof does not name.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema change and no row written by this PR.

verification.observation_window: Delivery verify; then identity-capture-work review_pack no longer lists the 13 candidates after the next discovery turn per category, and an approve-f1-batch dry run counts them under rule retained_positive_unique_physical_artwork_review.
